description: Capability for the main window. The six folder-sync permissions (M71, decision D37) are the ONLY filesystem grant this application has: they allow reading, writing, listing and deleting `.elrsp` profile files inside the ONE directory the user picks in the native folder dialog, and nothing else. The directory itself is granted at runtime by `folder-sync:allow-grant`, which canonicalises the picked path and REPLACES any previous grant; every other folder-sync command resolves a bare file name inside that single root and refuses separators, `..`, drive prefixes, absolute paths, reserved device names, symlinks and non-`.elrsp` names (see `folder_sync::resolve_in_root` in src/commands/config.rs). `tauri-plugin-fs` is deliberately not a dependency, so no other filesystem reach exists in the ACL.
